describe.title: Describe your problem
describe.body: Search directly, browse categories, or (soon) describe your situation to the AI Discovery assistant.

compare.title: Compare experts
compare.body: See clear scopes, prices, delivery times and payment terms before you commit.

work.title: Work and pay safely
work.body: Agree terms upfront, keep all communication on Greco, and pay only through a regulated provider.

home.expertCtaBody: Offer fixed-scope services to businesses looking for AI help. Greco's commission is {commission} per payment; there's no listing fee.

howItWorks.title: How Greco works
howItWorks.intro: Greco connects businesses with AI specialists and agencies, with clear terms and fair handling when things go wrong.

find.title: Find the right help
find.body: Search services, browse categories or compare expert profiles. Every service shows its scope, price, delivery time and payment terms.

agree.title: Agree the terms
agree.body: Order a listed service or ask for a custom offer. The price, payment schedule, deadline, revisions and cancellation terms are fixed before you pay.

pay.title: Pay through a regulated provider
pay.body: Greco never stores card details. Depending on the service you pay in full or a deposit before work starts. Clients pay no service fee.

deliver.title: Review and accept
deliver.body: Request revisions within the agreed terms. If something goes wrong, use the Resolution Center to agree a refund or ask Greco to review.

profile.title: Create your profile
profile.body: Show your skills, languages, links and case studies. Greco reviews every new profile and service before it goes public.

services.title: Publish services
services.body: Offer packages, fixed prices, hourly work or custom quotes, and choose full payment or a deposit for each service.

earn.title: Get paid for accepted work
earn.body: Greco's commission is {commission} of each payment, deducted from your earnings. There's no fee to join or list.

howItWorks.trust: Profiles and portfolios are self-reported unless marked as verified. All communication stays on Greco so agreements and evidence are in one place. Payments go live once our payment provider and legal set-up are confirmed.

becomeExpert.title: Offer your AI services on Greco
becomeExpert.intro: Businesses come to Greco to find specialists who can deliver real AI systems: agents, chatbots, voice automation, data and ML.

clients.title: Clients with real projects
clients.body: Clients describe business problems; AI Discovery (coming soon) helps them understand what they need before they reach you.

terms.title: Clear terms, protected work
terms.body: Scope, price, deadline and revisions are agreed upfront. You choose full payment or a deposit before you start.

fees.title: Simple pricing
fees.body: No subscription and no listing fee. Greco's commission is {commission} of each payment, deducted from your earnings.

steps.account: Create an account and choose "Offer services".
steps.profile: Complete your profile: headline, about, skills and languages.
steps.service: Create your first service with clear scope and pricing.
steps.review: Submit both for review. We'll check them and publish them.
